_comment: Post-fight tuning: what a bot learns from a fight. Every number is a first guess, not balance. drift_rules map ActionTag labels to personality poles; TODO(decision: d-personality-map) until the mapping is signed off.
_drift_rule_sets_comment: Other drift mappings the d-personality-map switch (data/variants/variants.json) can pick instead of drift_rules. by_target: only what a bot aims its skills at moves it. Rules are in the drift_rules format.
_drift_comment: Each personality spectrum holds two ends that only grow. Every push adds per_push to its end; one end grows at most max_per_end_per_fight in one fight. With tag-weight = per_energy (data/variants/variants.json) a decision counts as energy spent / energy_per_push pushes.
_skill_levels_comment: Flat levels (skill-progression = flat_levels). Named ranks read data/combat/skill_ranks.json instead.
_level_up_callout_comment: The readout's level-up callout shows damage against a target with this much defense (0: the skill's raw damage).
_combat_skill_effects_comment: Combat skill id -> bot skill effect_id. A use of the combat skill counts toward the bot skill with that effect. Empty means no bot skill matches. Must agree with bot_skill_effects in data/combat/combat_tuning.json (a test checks).
